strings.privacy.title: Ubumfihlo
strings.privacy.description: Indlela i-pdffusion ephatha ngayo amafayili akho: akukho akhawunti, akukho phepha eligcinwayo, akukho zikhangiso futhi akukho kuthengiswa kwemininingwane.
strings.privacy.intro: I-pdffusion yakhelwe ukuthi amaphepha akho ahlale angawakho. Nanka, ngamazwi acacileyo, okwenzekayo uma uyisebenzisa.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Amafayili akho
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Athunyelwa ngokuvikelekileyo (HTTPS), acubungulwe ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asuswa ngokushesha lapho umphumela usulungele. Amafayili amakhulu adlula kwindawo yokugcina yesikhashana ngaphansi kwegama elingahleliwe futhi asuswa ngokushesha lapho ukucubungula kuphela; ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo kususa konke okungase kusale phakathi kwamahora angu-24 okungenani.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Akukho akhawunti, akukho mininingwane yomuntu
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: I-pdffusion ayiceli ukubhalisa, ikheli le-imeyili noma ikhadi lezikweletu. Amaphepha akho awafundwa, ahlaziywa, abelwa noma asetshenziselwa ukuqeqesha ubuchopho bokuzenzela.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Ukulinganiswa kwezivakashi
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Sibala ukuvakasha ngaphandle kokwaziwa nangaphandle kwamakhukhini (Vercel Web Analytics) ukuze sifunde ukuthi yimaphi amathuluzi awusizo. Akukho zikhangiso, akukho ukulandelela okuvela kwezinye izingosi.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Amakhukhini
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Ikhukhini elilodwa, elizikhethelayo: likhumbula ulimi olukhethileyo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Ukusingathwa
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Isiza singathwa yi-Vercel eziphaketheni e-Paris; ukuguqulwa kwe-Word, Excel ne-PowerPoint kuphathwa yi-Render e-Frankfurt. Laba abahlinzeki baphethe amafayili isikhathi sokuguqula kuphela.

strings.legal.terms.title: Imigomo yokusebenzisa
strings.legal.terms.description: i-pdffusion imahhala kumuntu wonke, kubandakanya amabhizinisi lohulumeni. Imibhalo yakho ihlala ingeyakho: kakho ohluzayo loba ogcinayo.

strings.legal.terms.sections[0].text: i-pdffusion idizayinwe, yakhiwa futhi yakhitshwa nguMikailou Cedric Toure, umthuthuki ohlala eNew Brunswick, eCanada.
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].title: Ilayisensi yamahhala yokusebenzisa, kumuntu wonke
strings.legal.terms.sections[1].text: i-pdffusion imahhala, ngaphandle kokubhalisa nangaphandle komkhawulo wesikhathi, kumuntu wonke: abantu ngabanye, abafundi, othitshala, amabhizinisi, izinhlangano ezingenzi nzuzo, imibuso kawonkewonke lohulumeni, eCanada nakwezinye izizwe zonke. Akula lutho olubekelwe icebo elibhadalalwayo, ngoba kalikho. Amafayela owakhicizayo ngawakho ngokuphelele: kawalophawu lwamandla loba ukukhulunywa kwe-pdffusion.
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].title: Yonke imibhalo yakho, loba eyimfihlo
strings.legal.terms.sections[2].text: Ungasebenza nganoma yiluphi uhlolomibhalo, kubandakanya lezo eziyimfihlo, ngoba i-pdffusion kayibali, kayihluzi, kayigcini loba kayihlanganyeli amafayela akho: asetshenziswa ngokuzenzakalelayo bese asuswa. Uhlala ungowayo, futhi nguwe ophendulayo ngokuba lamalungelo adingekayo wokuwasebenza.

strings.legal.terms.sections[3].text: Ikhowudi yomthombo ye-pdffusion ikhitshwa ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-MIT. Ungayibala, uyihlole, uyifake kumaseva akho (kubandakanya kwinethiwekhi evaliweyo engekho inthanethi), uyilungise futhi uyihambise mahhala, inxa ugcine isaziso selungelo lokukopa lombhalo welayisensi.
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].title: Ukusebenzisa okwamukelekayo
strings.legal.terms.sections[4].text: Awumele usebenzise i-pdffusion emsebenzini ongekho emthethweni, uzame ukuphazamisa inkonzo (ukulayisha okukhulu okuzenzakalelayo, imizamo yokungena) loba ukweqa imida yobuchwepheshe. Ubukhulu lemikhawulo yenani lefayela kuvikela inkonzo kumuntu wonke.
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].title: Ukutholakala
strings.legal.terms.sections[5].text: i-pdffusion inikwa mahhala. Ingatshintsha, iphazanyiswe ngenxa yokugcinwa loba ivalwe. Gcina njalo imibhalo yakho yokuqala: i-pdffusion kayigcini khophi yayo.
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].title: Iwaranti lobophezelo
strings.legal.terms.sections[6].text: Inkonzo inikwa “injengoba injalo”, ngaphandle kwewaranti yanoma yiluphi uhlobo. Ngokugcwele okuvunyelwe ngumthetho, umshicileli kaphenduli ngomonakalo wokungaqondanga, ukulahleka kwemininingwane loba umphumela wokuguqula ongaphelelanga. Hlola imibhalo oyakhicizayo ungayisebenzisela okunye okubalulekile.
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].title: Impahla yengqondo
strings.legal.terms.sections[7].text: Igama le-pdffusion, ilogo yayo lemibhalo yendawo ngeyomshicileli; ikhowudi ingaphansi kwelayisensi ye-MIT njengoba kutshiwo ngenhla. Izimpawu ezikhulunyiweyo (PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint…) nge zabanikazi bazo.

strings.legal.security.title: Ezokuphepha lemininingwane
strings.legal.security.description: Yini eyenzeka kumafayela akho ku-pdffusion: ukusebenza okuzenzakalelayo, kungekho ukuhluzwa, ukususwa ngokushesha, ukufihla ngemfihlo, ukusingathwa eYurophu, lokukhetha ukuyifaka kumaseva akho.
strings.legal.security.intro: Yini eyenzeka kumafayela akho, lapho asetshenziswa khona lakuthi avikelwa njani: kuchazwe kalula, kubantu ngabanye nakumaphethelo obuchwepheshe ngokufanayo.
strings.legal.security.sections[0].title: Kakho imibhalo egcinwayo
strings.legal.security.sections[0].text: Amafayela akho asetshenziswa ngokuzenzakalelayo, bese asuswa masinyane nje nxa umphumela usukulungele loba sewudawunilodiwe. Kakho ikhophi, kakho isipele futhi akula umlando. Ukuhlanzwa okuzenzakalelayo kwansuku zonke kucisha loba yiliphi fayela lesikhashana elingase lisale, ngosuku olulandelayo kungakapheli.
strings.legal.security.sections[1].title: Kungekho ukuhluzwa
strings.legal.security.sections[1].text: Kakho obala imibhalo yakho. Kayifakwanga ohlwini, kayihluzwanga, kayihlanganyelwanga loba isetshenziselwa ukuqeqesha ubuchwepheshe bokuhlakanipha. i-pdffusion kayilama-akhawunti, kayilazikhangiso futhi kayilamaphrofayili abasebenzisi.
strings.legal.security.sections[2].title: Ukufihla ngemfihlo
strings.legal.security.sections[2].text: Yonke inhlangano ifihliwe (HTTPS) futhi indawo iqinisekisa ukufihla kukho konke ukuvakasha (HSTS). Ithuluzi Lokuvikela lifihla ama-PDF akho nge-AES-256; ipasiwedi oyikhethayo kayilondolozwa ndawonye.
strings.legal.security.sections[3].title: Lapho amafayela akho asetshenziswa khona
strings.legal.security.sections[3].text: Indawo, amatshe e-PDF lezithombe: i-Vercel, isikhungo semininingwane saseParis (France, European Union). Ukuguqula i-Word, Excel le-PowerPoint: i-Render, eFrankfurt (Germany, European Union). Amafayela adlula u-4 MB: indawo yokugcina yesikhashana ye-Vercel Blob, ngaphansi kwegama elingaziwayo, elisuswe ngemuva kokusetshenziswa.
strings.legal.security.sections[4].title: Ukuvikeleka kobuchwepheshe
strings.legal.security.sections[4].text: Izihloko zokuphepha (HSTS, ukuvimbela indawo ukuthi ingafakwa kwamanye amakhasi, ukuvikeleka ekudidekeni kohlobo lwefayela), amakheli efayela lesikhashana angenakuzwiwa, lenkonzo yokuguqula eyamukela kuphela izicelo eziphethe ithokheni eyimfihlo. Lonke utshintsho lwekhowudi luhlollwa ngokuzenzakalelayo (izivivinyo, ukuhlola izinhlobo) ngaphambi kokuba lisebenze bukhoma.
strings.legal.security.sections[5].title: Ubumfihlo lomthetho osebenzayo
strings.legal.security.sections[5].text: i-pdffusion ikhitshwa eNew Brunswick futhi ihambisana noMthetho Wokuvikelwa Kwemininingwane Yabantu Bobunjalo Lamazwi Wama-elektronizi (PIPEDA) waseCanada. Kayibutheli mininingwane yomuntu ngaye ngabasebenzisi bayo: akula-akhawunti, akuleveli yemeyili, akula khukhi yokulandela. Yakhiwe phezu kwemigomo efana ne-GDPR yaseYurophu lomthetho 25 waseQuebec: ukunciphisa imininingwane, kungaphinde kusetshenziswe, ukususwa ngemuva kokusebenza.
strings.legal.security.sections[6].title: Ezinhlanganweni ezilemithetho eqinileyo
strings.legal.security.sections[6].text: Inxa imithetho yakho ivimba ukuthumela imibhalo kunkonzo yangaphandle, faka i-pdffusion kumaseva akho. Isoftware ephelele imahhala, ingeyomthombo ovulekileyo futhi isebenza ngaphandle kokuxhumana inthanethi: akula fayela eliphumayo kunethiwekhi yakho. Umhlahlandlela wokufaka usekhasini lephrojekthi.
strings.legal.security.sections[7].title: Ukuba obala
strings.legal.security.sections[7].text: Ikhowudi yomthombo ephelele yeyomphakathi: amaqembu akho okuphepha angabona ngeso lengqondo ngayinye yalezi zitatimende.

strings.legal.security.sections[8].text: Ucabanga ukuthi uthole ubuthakathaka bokuphepha? Kubike ngokuyimfihlo kusuka kuthebhu “Security” yelizwe lephrojekthi:
strings.legal.accessibility.title: Okokungena kalula
strings.legal.accessibility.description: Isitatimende sokungena kalula se-pdffusion: inhloso ye-WCAG 2.2 ezingeni le-AA, amanyathelo akhona, imida eyaziwayo lendlela yokubika isithiyo.
strings.legal.accessibility.intro: Umuntu wonke kumele akwazi ukusebenzisa i-pdffusion, kubandakanya abantu abangaboniyo loba abalokubona okuncane, abangezwa loba abalobunzima bokuzwa, loba abalobunzima bokuhamba loba bengqondo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].title: Okuhlosiwe okuseqophelweni
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[0].text: i-pdffusion ihlose ukuhambisana Nezinkombandlela Zokungena Kalula Kombhalo Wewebhu (WCAG) 2.2, ezingeni le-AA, okuyisilinganiso samazwe ngamazwe seW3C. Leli zinga livala izidingo Zesilinganiso Sohulumeni WaseCanada Sokungena Kalula Kwebwebu, isilinganiso saseYurophu EN 301 549 leSahluko 508 eUnited States, ezikhomba i-WCAG 2.0 loba 2.1 ezingeni le-AA.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].title: Isimo sokuhambisana
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[1].text: i-pdffusion ihambisana kancane ne-WCAG 2.2 ezingeni le-AA: imida eyaziwayo ibhalwe ngezansi. Lesi sitatimende sisekelwe ekuhloleni kwangaphakathi okwenziwe ngoLwezi 2, 2026, kusetshenziswa amathuluzi azenzakalelayo (i-axe, i-Lighthouse) lokuhlola ngesandla (ibhodi lokhiye, ukugqama, ukukhulisa, izaziso). Akukho ukuhlola okuzimeleyo okwenziwe okwakhathesi.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].title: Okukhona endaweni
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[2].text: Lonke isayithi lisebenza ngekhibhodi, kune-link “Skip to content” kanye nomkhawulo obonakalayo entweni esebenzayo. Ukuqhathaniswa kombhalo kungcono okungenani kube ngu-4.5:1. Izinyathelo zomsebenzi (ukulayisha, umphumela, iphutha) zimenyezelwa kwizifundi zesikrini. Ukulandelana kwamafayela kungashintshwa ngaphandle kokudonsela phansi, kusetshenziswa izinkinobho. Isayithi lilandela isilungiselelo sedivayisi yakho sokwehlisa ukunyakaza “reduce motion”: izithombe ezinyakazayo bese zima ngokuphelele. Amakhasi ahlala efundeka kusayizi ongu-400% nasemascingwini. Ulimi lwekhasi ngalinye liyamenyezwa, kanti isi-Arabhu siboniswa kusuka ngesokudla kuya ngesokhohlo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].title: Imida eyaziwayo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[3].text: Ngaphandle kwaloo silungiselelo, izithombe zokuhlobisa ezinyakazayo (ingemuva, indilinga, ithikha yefomethi) ziyaqhubeka zisebenza; ithikha iyama uma uyibeka phezu kwayo noma usebenzisa ikhibhodi. Indilinga enyakazayo ekhasini lasekhaya isetshenziswa ngegundane noma ngomunwe; ingeyokuhlobisa, futhi uhlu lwezifomethi eziboniswayo lukhona njengombhalo ekhasini. Izilimi ezihunyushwe ngomshini zingaba namaphutha. Ekugcineni, ukufikeleleka kwedokhumenti ekhiqiziwe kuncike kweyokuqala: i-pdffusion ayifaki amathegi okufikeleleka ku-PDF engenayo.
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[4].title: Bika isithiyo
strings.legal.accessibility.sections[4].text: Ingxenye yesayithi ikudalele inkinga? Ichaze kusuka ekhasini lephrojekthi; sihlose ukuphendula phakathi kwezinsuku zokusebenza eziyi-10 futhi sinikeze enye indlela uma ukulungisa kuthatha isikhathi eside:
strings.legal.install.title: i-pdffusion yezinhlangano
strings.legal.install.description: Faka i-pdffusion kumaseva kahulumeni wakho loba omsebenzi: kumahhala, kuyomthombo ovulekileyo, futhi imibhalo yakho kayiphumi kwinethiwekhi yakho.
strings.legal.install.intro: Uhulumeni, amabhizinisi, izibhedlela, izikole: faka i-pdffusion ngaphakathi ngemizuzu futhi ugcine ukulawula okuphelele kwemibhalo yakho.
strings.legal.install.sections[0].title: Imibhalo yakho ihlala kwinethiwekhi yakho
strings.legal.install.sections[0].text: Konke ukusebenza kwenzeka kumaseva akho, ngaphandle kokuxhumana inthanethi. Akula ukuhluzwa kwemininingwane, akula nkonzo yangaphandle, akula-akhawunti.
strings.legal.install.sections[1].title: Konke okufakiweyo
strings.legal.install.sections[1].text: Lonke ithuluzi le-pdffusion, izinhlobo ezingaphezu kwangu-40, i-LibreOffice ye-Word, Excel le-PowerPoint, lezilimi zokusebenzisa ezingu-160 zonke, esitsheni esisodwa.
strings.legal.install.sections[2].title: Mahhala futhi ingeyomthombo ovulekileyo
strings.legal.install.sections[2].text: i-pdffusion ikhitshwa ngaphansi kwelayisensi ye-MIT: imahhala ukufaka, ukusebenzisa lokulungisa, ngaphandle komkhawulo wabasebenzisi. Amaqembu akho okuphepha angahlola yonke ikhowudi.

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Nciphisa i-PDF ukuze uyithumele nge-imeyili noma uyilayishele kusiza esisemthethweni. Amazinga amathathu wokunciphisa, mahhala.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Ingabe ifayela lakho lisinda kakhulu imeyili loba indawo yewebhu? Lidonsele, gcina “Okuncomeswayo” bese ucofa Nciphisa. Umbhalo uhlala ubukhali.
strings.tools.compresser.options.level.label: Kumele kunciphe kangakanani?
strings.tools.compresser.options.level.hints.str: Kuncane ngangokunokwenzeka; izithombe ziba mnyama kancane.
strings.tools.compresser.guide.keywords: nciphisa i-pdf, yehlisa ubukhulu be-pdf, yenza i-pdf ibe lula, i-pdf isinda kakhulu, nciphisa i-pdf yemeyili
strings.tools.compresser.guide.uses[1]: Layisha umbhalo kwingosi enomkhawulo wobukhulu (kanengi 2 kuya ku-5 MB).
strings.tools.compresser.guide.steps[0].title: Donsela i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.compresser.guide.steps[1].title: Gcina "Okuncomeswayo"
strings.tools.compresser.guide.steps[1].text: Loba khetha Okukhanya loba Okukhulu kakhulu ngokwendlela yobukhulu obudingayo.
strings.tools.compresser.guide.steps[2].title: Cofa Nciphisa
strings.tools.compresser.guide.steps[2].text: i-pdffusion kutshengisa inzuzo, isibonelo "8 MB → 2 MB".
strings.tools.compresser.guide.faq[0].q: Ingabe ukunciphisa kwenza umbhalo ube mnyama?
strings.tools.compresser.guide.faq[0].a: Cha: umbhalo uhlala ubukhali. Izithombe kuphela eziba lula, kancane kakhulu kwimo yokuNcomeswayo.
strings.tools.compresser.guide.faq[1].a: Kungenzeka yayilungiselelwe kakade; i-pdffusion iyakutshela njalo.
strings.tools.proteger.name: Vikela
strings.tools.proteger.seoDescription: Faka ikhodi ku-PDF ngephasiwedi (AES-256) uvimbele ukuprinta, ukukopa noma ukuhlela. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.proteger.intro: Ngaphambi kokuthumela isitatimende somholo noma iphepha lezempilo, khiya ngephasiwedi eqinile: ngaphandle kwalo, akekho ongayivula.
strings.tools.proteger.options.password.label: Iphasiwedi yokuvula
strings.tools.proteger.options.noPrint.label: Vimba ukuprinta
strings.tools.proteger.options.noCopy.label: Vimba ukukopa umbhalo
strings.tools.proteger.options.noEdit.label: Vimba ukuhlela
strings.tools.proteger.guide.keywords: vikela i-pdf ngempawu, fihla i-pdf, vikela i-pdf, engeza ipasiwedi ku-pdf, vimbela ukuprinta i-pdf
strings.tools.proteger.guide.uses[0]: Thumela irisidi, umbhalo wezempilo loba inkontileka abantu abangaziyo abangayifundiyo.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.uses[1]: Vimbela ukuprinta, ukukopa loba ukulungisa umbhalo.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[0].title: Donsela i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[1].title: Khetha ipasiwedi
strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[1].text: Futhi, nxa kudingeka, okungavunyelwanga: ukuprinta, ukukopa, ukulungisa.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[2].title: Cofa Vikela
strings.tools.proteger.guide.steps[2].text: I-PDF ifihlwe nge-AES-256; hlanganyela ipasiwedi ngenye indlela.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.faq[0].a: Yebo: AES-256, isigaba esisetshenziswa ngamabhangi lohulumeni. Ngaphandle kwepasiwedi, okuqukethwe akukwazi ukubalwa.
strings.tools.proteger.guide.faq[1].a: Cha, kayilondolozwa ndawonye. Inxa uyikhohlwa, kakho ongavula ifayela.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.name: Vula
strings.tools.deverrouiller.tagline: Susa iphepha ku-PDF owazi iphasiwedi yalo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.seoDescription: Susa iphasiwedi ku-PDF owazi iphasiwedi yayo, ukuze uyivule, uyiprinte noma uyihlanganise ngokukhululekileyo. Mahhala.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Uyazi iphasiwedi, kodwa ukuyithayipha njalo kuyinkinga? Yisuse kanye kuphela. I-pdffusion ayize yehlise iphasiwedi ongayaziyo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.options.password.hel: Shiya kungenalutho uma i-PDF inamaphasiwedi wemvume kuphela.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.keywords: vula i-pdf, sula ipasiwedi ye-pdf, sula ukuvikeleka kwe-pdf, khipha ukufihla kwe-pdf
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.uses[0]: Yekela ukuthayipha ipasiwedi ngaso sonke isikhathi nxa uvula umbhalo ongowakho.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.uses[1]: Sula ukuvikeleka ngaphambi kokuhlanganisa loba ukulungisa i-PDF.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.uses[2]: Gcina imibhalo ngaphandle kokubeka engozini ukulahlekelwa yipasiwedi yayo.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[0].title: Donsela i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[1].title: Faka ipasiwedi yayo
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[1].text: Ukuhlola kuqala kuvela masinyane nje nxa kuqondile.
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.steps[2].title: Cofa Vula
strings.tools.deverrouiller.guide.faq[0].a: Cha. i-pdffusion isusa ukuvikeleka kuphela emibhalweni owazi ipasiwedi yayo.
strings.tools.metadonnees.name: Imininingwane yephepha
strings.tools.metadonnees.tagline: Lungisa isihloko, umbhali, isihloko esikhulu namagama angukhiye.
strings.tools.metadonnees.seoDescription: Shintsha isihloko, umbhali, isihloko esikhulu namagama angukhiye e-PDF, noma ususe konke. Mahhala, ku-intanethi, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.metadonnees.intro: Isihloko esiboniswa kuthebhu yesiphequluli noma igama lombhali lidalula isifanekiso esidala? Lungisa izimpawu zephepha, noma uzisuse ngaphambi kokwabelana.
strings.tools.metadonnees.options.title.label: Isihloko
strings.tools.metadonnees.options.author.label: Umbhali
strings.tools.metadonnees.options.subject.label: Isihloko esikhulu
strings.tools.metadonnees.options.keywords.label: Amagama angukhiye (ahlukaniswe ngo-koma)
strings.tools.metadonnees.options.clear.label: Susa yonke imininingwane ekhona
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.keywords: lungisa imethedatha ye-pdf, tshintsha isihloko se-pdf, umbhali we-pdf, izakhiwo ze-pdf, sula imethedatha ye-pdf
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.uses[0]: Nika i-PDF isihloko sangempela (esitshengiswe kuthebhu yesiphequluli).
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.uses[1]: Sula umbhali loba igama lesoftware ngaphambi kokuba uprinte umbhalo.
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.uses[2]: Engeza amagama asemqoka ukuze uthole imibhalo yakho kalula.
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.steps[0].title: Donsela i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.steps[1].title: Gcwalisa izikhala
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.steps[1].text: Isihloko, umbhali, udaba, amagama asemqoka, loba maka inketho yokuzisula zonke.
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.steps[2].title: Cofa Imethedatha
strings.tools.metadonnees.guide.faq[0].a: Ulwazi olufihliweyo efayeleni: isihloko, umbhali, isoftware esetshenzisiweyo, izinsuku. Kungatshengisa ukuthi ubani owadala umbhalo.
strings.tools.signer.name: Sayina
strings.tools.signer.seoDescription: Dweba, thayipha loba layisha isayiniso sakho bese usibeka ku-PDF yakho, losuku lwanamhlanje nxa kudingeka. Mahhala, akulakubhalisa, amafayela asuswa ngokushesha.
strings.tools.signer.intro: Dweba isayiniso sakho ngegawuni yakho loba ngomunwe (loba thayipha igama lakho), khetha ikhasi lendawo, bese ucofa Sayina. Lesi yisayiniso sokubonakalayo, esifana nesesandla esiskeniweyo.
strings.tools.signer.options.signature.label: Isayiniso sakho
strings.tools.signer.options.where.label: Kusiphi ikhasi?
strings.tools.signer.options.pages.label: Amakhasi
strings.tools.signer.options.position.label: Kufanele kusayinwe kuphi?
strings.tools.signer.options.size.label: Ubukhulu
strings.tools.signer.options.date.label: Faka usuku lwanamuhla ngaphansi kwesiginesha
strings.tools.signer.guide.keywords: sayina i-PDF, sayina i-PDF ku-inthanethi mahhala, faka isiginesha ku-PDF, sayina idokhumenti nge-elekthronikhi, isiginesha yesandla ku-PDF
strings.tools.signer.guide.uses[0]: Sayina inkontileka yokuqasha, yesisebenzi kumbe imvume ungaphrintanga kumbe ukopisha.
strings.tools.signer.guide.uses[1]: Faka izithonjana zakho zamagama emakhasini wonke enkontileka.
strings.tools.signer.guide.uses[2]: Sayina usuka efonini yakho, ngomunwe wakho.
strings.tools.signer.guide.steps[0].title: Faka i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.signer.guide.steps[1].title: Dala isiginesha yakho
strings.tools.signer.guide.steps[1].text: Yidwebe, thayipha igama lakho kumbe ufake isithombe.
strings.tools.signer.guide.steps[2].title: Khetha ikhasi nendawo
strings.tools.signer.guide.faq[0].a: Yisiginesha elula yama-elekthronikhi, enjengekopši yesandla: yanele emisebenzini yonke yansuku zonke. Eminye imisebenzi esemthethweni idinga isiginesha eqinisekisiwe yama-elekthronikhi enesitifiketi.
strings.tools.signer.guide.faq[1].a: Cha: isetshenziselwa idokhumenti yakho kuphela, bese isuswa kanye nayo.
strings.tools.caviarder.name: Fihla imininingwane
strings.tools.caviarder.seoTitle: Fihla imininingwane ku-PDF: fihla ulwazi unomphela
strings.tools.caviarder.seoDescription: Susa ngempela amagama, amakheli, izinombolo kanye nezindawo ku-PDF: okuqukethwe okufihliwe kusulwa kufayela, hatshi ukumbozwa nje. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.caviarder.intro: Thayipha amagama okufanele asuswe, maka ulwazi okumele lutholakale (ama-imeyili, izinombolo zocingo…) kumbe udwebe onxande emakhasini. I-pdffusion isula ngempela okuqukethwe okufihliwe: akunakubuyiswa ngokukopisha umbhalo kumbe ukususa ibhokisi elimnyama.
strings.tools.caviarder.options.terms.label: Amagama okufanele asuswe
strings.tools.caviarder.options.terms.help: Hlukanisa ngo-komba. Wonke amagama atholakalayo asuswa, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi amakhulu noma amancane.
strings.tools.caviarder.options.patterns.label: Thola ngokuzenzakalelayo
strings.tools.caviarder.options.areas.label: Izindawo okumele zifihlwe
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.keywords: fihla imininingwane ku-PDF, fihla ubuwena ku-PDF, faka umbala omnyama wombhalo ku-PDF, susa ulwazi oluyimfihlo ku-PDF, cisha ku-PDF
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.uses[0]: Fihla ubuwena budokhumenti ngaphambi kokukushicilela kumbe ukukwabelana (amagama, amakheli, izinombolo).
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.uses[1]: Phendula isicelo sokufinyelela kulwazi ngokususwa kwedatha evikelwe.
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.uses[2]: Yabelana ngesitatimende sasebhange ngenkathi ufihla izinombolo ze-akhawunti.
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.steps[0].title: Faka i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.steps[0].text: Ukubuka kuqala kukhombisa onke amakhasi ayo.
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.steps[1].title: Sho ukuthi yini okufanele ifihlwe
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.steps[1].text: Thayipha amagama, maka izinhlobo zolwazi kumbe udwebe izindawo emakhasini.
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.steps[2].title: Chofoza Fihla imininingwane
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.steps[2].text: Okuqukethwe okufihliwe kusulwa kufayela, hatshi ukumbozwa nje.
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.faq[0].a: Unxande obekwe phezulu ushiya umbhalo kufayela: ungakopishwa kumbe unxande ususwe. Ukufihla kwe-pdffusion kusula ngempela umbhalo nezithombe ezisezansi kwendawo leyo.
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.faq[1].q: Ingabe ukusebenzisa amagama amakhulu noma amancane kuqakathekile?
strings.tools.caviarder.guide.faq[1].a: Cha: "Smith" kususa njalo u-"SMITH" kanye no-"smith".
strings.tools.ocr.name: Funda iskeni
strings.tools.ocr.tagline: Yenza umbhalo wedokhumenti eskeniwe kumbe ethwetshulwe ngesithombe ukwazi ukusesheka nokukopiseka.
strings.tools.ocr.seoTitle: I-OCR yamahhala ku-intherethi: yenza i-PDF eskeniwe ikwazi ukusesheka
strings.tools.ocr.seoDescription: Funda umbhalo we-PDF eskeniwe kumbe isithombe (OCR) ukuze ukwazi ukuwusesha, ukuwakopisha kumbe ukuwufunda ngokuzwakalayo. Izilimi eziyi-16, mahhala, idokhumenti ayilayishwa.
strings.tools.ocr.intro: Idokhumenti eskeniwe kumbe ethwetshulwe ngesithombe yisithombe nje: ungeke ukwazi ukusesha igama kumbe ukukopisha umusho. Funda iskeni kuyazi zonke izinhlamvu (lokhu kubizwa nge-OCR) futhi kufaka umbhalo weqiniso edokhumentini ngaphandle kokuguqula ukubukeka kwayo. Ukufunda kwenzeka kumakhalekhukhwini wakho: idokhumenti yakho ayilayishwa. Isibonelo solimi olukhethiwe (amameyabhithi ambalwa) kuphela esilandwayo kanye.
strings.tools.ocr.options.lang.label: Ulimi lwedokhumenti
strings.tools.ocr.options.format.label: Umphumela
strings.tools.ocr.options.format.hints.pdf: Idokhumenti efanayo, enombhalo ongawusesha futhi uwukopishe.
strings.tools.ocr.options.format.hints.txt: Umbhalo kuphela, ukuze uwusebenzise kwenye indawo.
strings.tools.ocr.guide.keywords: i-OCR ku-inthanethi, i-OCR yamahhala, i-PDF eskeniwe ibe ngumbhalo, yenza i-PDF isesheke, ukubonwa kombhalo, kopisha umbhalo kusuka eskenini, isithombe sibe ngumbhalo
strings.tools.ocr.guide.uses[0]: Thola igama enkontilekani ende eskeniwe usebenzisa u-Ctrl + F.
strings.tools.ocr.guide.uses[1]: Kopisha umbhalo we-invoyisi kumbe incwadi ethwetshulwe ngesithombe.
strings.tools.ocr.guide.uses[2]: Yenza ingqoloyi yamaphepha edijithali ifinyeleleke kubantu abangaboniyo.
strings.tools.ocr.guide.steps[0].title: Faka iskeni sakho
strings.tools.ocr.guide.steps[1].title: Khetha ulimi
strings.tools.ocr.guide.steps[2].title: Chofoza Funda iskeni
strings.tools.ocr.guide.steps[2].text: Uthola i-PDF lapho umbhalo ungaseshwa futhi ukopishwe, kumbe ifayela lombhalo.
strings.tools.ocr.guide.faq[0].a: Ukubonwa kwezinhlamvu zokukhanya: ikhompyutha ibona izinhlamvu ezisesithombeni ukuze iziguqule zibe ngumbhalo weqiniso.
strings.tools.ocr.guide.faq[1].a: Cha: ukufunda kwenzeka ngokuphelele kudivayisi yakho. Isibonelo solimi kuphela esilandwayo, kanye.
strings.tools.remplir.name: Gcwalisa ifomu
strings.tools.remplir.tagline: Gcwalisa ifomu le-PDF ngokuqondile kusiphequluli sakho.
strings.tools.remplir.seoDescription: Gcwalisa izikhala zefomu le-PDF (umbhalo, amabhokisi okuhlola, izinhlu) ngaphandle kwesoftuwa, bese uyayilayishwa igcwalisiwe, ikhiyiwe uma uthanda. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.remplir.intro: Faka ifomu le-PDF: i-pdffusion ithola zonke izikhala futhi izikhombisa njengefomu elula. Yigcwalise, hlola ukubuka kuqala, bese uchofoza Gcwalisa ifomu ukuze ulande i-PDF egcwalisiwe.
strings.tools.remplir.options.values.label: Izimpendulo
strings.tools.remplir.options.lock.label: Khiya izimpendulo (ifomu ngeke lisakwazi ukuhlelwa)
strings.tools.remplir.guide.keywords: gcwalisa i-PDF, gcwalisa ifomu le-PDF ku-inthanethi, gcwalisa ifomu le-PDF, thayipha kwifomu le-PDF, umgcwalisi wefomu le-PDF wamahhala
strings.tools.remplir.guide.uses[0]: Gcwalisa ifomu likahulumeni (isicelo, ukubhaliswa, isimemezelo) ngaphandle kokuliphrintatha.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.uses[2]: Khiya izimpendulo zakho ngaphambi kokuthumela idokhumenti.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[0].title: Faka ifomu
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[0].text: I-pdffusion ithola zonke izikhala okumele zigcwaliswe.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[1].title: Gcwalisa izikhala
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[1].text: Ukubuka kuqala kukhombisa izimpendulo zakho endaweni yazo ekhasini.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.steps[2].title: Chofoza Gcwalisa ifomu
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[0].a: I-PDF kayisisi sikhala esisebenzisanayo (kuvame ukuba yiskeni). Kuzomele uyiphrinte kumbe ucele inhlangano inguqulo esebenzisanayo.
strings.tools.remplir.guide.faq[1].a: Izimpendulo ziba yinxenye yekhasi futhi azisakwazi ukuguqulwa.
strings.tools.comparer.name: Qhathanisa
strings.tools.comparer.tagline: Bona okuguqukile phakathi kwezinguqulo ezimbili ze-PDF.
strings.tools.comparer.seoTitle: Qhathanisa ama-PDF amabili ku-inthanethi: bona umehluko
strings.tools.comparer.seoDescription: Qhathanisa izinguqulo ezimbili zenkontileka kumbe yedokhumenti ye-PDF: amagama engeziwe aluhlaza, amagama asusiwe abomvu, nombiko ongawulanda. Mahhala, akukho okulayishelwayo.
strings.tools.comparer.intro: Faka inguqulo endala, bese ufaka entsha: umehluko uvela khona manjalo, igama ngegama. Chofoza Qhathanisa ukuze ulande umbiko. Konke kwenzeka kusiphequluli sakho.
strings.tools.comparer.options.ignoreCase.label: Ungalokothi ubheke izinhlamvu ezinkulu lezincane
strings.tools.comparer.guide.keywords: qhathanisa ama-PDF amabili, i-PDF diff, qhathanisa izinguqulo ezimbili zedokhumenti, qhathanisa izinkontileka, thola izinguquko ku-PDF
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[0]: Hlola okuguqukile enkontilekani kumbe eqashweni ngaphambi kokulisayina.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[1]: Buyekeza ukulungiswa okwenziwe embikweni kumbe ethesisini.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.uses[2]: Qhathanisa izinguqulo ezimbili zomthetho kumbe umbhalo osemthethweni.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[0].title: Faka inguqulo endala
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].title: Funda umehluko
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[1].text: Okuluhlaza kukhombisa okungeziwe, okubomvu okunqanyuliwe kukhombisa okususwayo.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.steps[2].title: Chofoza Qhathanisa
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[0].a: Cha: ukuqhathanisa kwenzeka ngokuphelele kusiphequluli sakho.
strings.tools.comparer.guide.faq[1].a: Yebo, emva kokusebenzisa ithuluzi le-Funda iskeni elikhipha umbhalo wazo.
strings.tools.images.name: Khipha izithombe
strings.tools.images.seoDescription: Thola zonke izithombe, imidwebo namalogo ku-PDF njenge-PNG kumbe i-JPG, ngaphandle kokuphindaphindeka. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa, amafayela asuswa khona manjalo.
strings.tools.images.intro: Faka i-PDF: i-pdffusion ithola zonke izithombe ezikuwo futhi ikunika zona ngazinye, njenge-PNG kumbe i-JPG, kufayela le-ZIP. Izithombe ezincane zokuhlobisa kanye nokuphindaphindeka kuyekwa.
strings.tools.images.options.format.label: Uhlobo lwesithombe
strings.tools.images.options.small.label: Gcina njalo izithombe ezincane (izimpawu, amachashazi)
strings.tools.images.guide.keywords: khipha izithombe ku-PDF, gcina izithombe ku-PDF, thola izithombe ngaphandle kwe-PDF, umkhiphi wezithombe ze-PDF
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[0]: Thola izithombe zekhalothi le-PDF, umbiko kumbe incwajana.
strings.tools.images.guide.uses[1]: Sebenzisa futhi ilogo kumbe ishadi kwethulo.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[0].title: Faka i-PDF yakho
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].title: Khetha i-PNG kumbe i-JPG
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[1].text: I-PNG yezingga ephezulu, i-JPG yamafayela alula.
strings.tools.images.guide.steps[2].title: Chofoza Khipha izithombe
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].q: Kuhluke ngani lokhu ekuguquleni i-PDF ibe ngu-JPG?
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[0].a: Ukuguqula kwenza ikhasi ngalinye libe yisithombe. Ukukhipha izithombe kuthola izithombe nemidwebo kuphela engaphakathi kwamakhasi, ngobukhulu bazo bokuqala.
strings.tools.images.guide.faq[1].a: Izithombe ezincane (izimpawu, amachashazi) ziyekwa ngokuzenzakalelayo: maka "Gcina njalo izithombe ezincane". Umbhalo nemidwebo ye-vector kayisizi zithombe, ngakho kayikhitshwa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.name: Nciphisa / nquma
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoTitle: Nciphisa ube usunquma izithombe ku-inthanethi mahhala
strings.tools.redimensionner.seoDescription: Nciphisa isithombe (ngokuthi % kumbe ngamaphikseli) kumbe usinqume sibe yisikwele, 16:9 kumbe 4:3, bese usigcina njenge-JPG, PNG kumbe WebP. Mahhala, akukho kubhalisa.
strings.tools.redimensionner.intro: Faka izithombe zakho, khetha ukuzinciphisa kumbe ukuzinquma, hlola ukubuka kuqala, bese uchofoza Nciphisa / nquma. Kulula esithombeni sephrofayili, okunamathiselwe okusindayo kumbe ifomu elidinga ubukhulu obuthile.
strings.tools.redimensionner.options.mode.label: Yenza njani?
Nquma amaphethelo ukuze uthole ifomethi eqondile.
